text: …　こりゃ　いい　ポケモンずかんに　なって　きとる！

structure.jp: いい　ポケモンずかんに

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says a change has been coming along bit by bit up to now. なって　きとる = 'has been becoming'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man, western-dialect way of saying ている, which shows something is going on now. きとる = きている = 'is coming along'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what something turns into. ずかんに　なって = 'becoming a Pokédex'.
